R O C K  A N D S T O N E / 10

I heard about this game and decided to give it a go and so far I have to say that I don't regret that decision at all. The game is currently still growing and is a blast to play. The community is great and very helpful.

All of the classes in the game are really fun to play.

The scout lights up large open caverns and has a hook shot to go basically anywhere. The Engineer creates portable platforms and turrets. The Gunner kills things and has C4. The driller tunnels faster and has a flame thrower.

All of the classes work well together and this really is a team based game (though you can play solo if you'd like). There are plenty of enemies and a few different mission types to do. The average game lasts about 20 minutes and is rather entertaining. Though you don't NEED all of the classes to do well but having them all makes things that much easier.

The graphics do their job and realy give you a feel for the game. Also just be mindful that the enemies are relentless when it comes to pursuing you, if you want to traverse safely make sure that everything around you is dead before you move on (unless you are running away to get to the escape pod of course).

It takes a while to get used to at first but after a few hours you'll be rarin to go and wanting more.  If you'd like to know more about the gameplay I would suggest watching a playthrough video on youtube or a steaming service like twitch. That will give you a feel for how the game works.

I would say that the only gripe that I have is that markers don't last long enough IMO and I feel like they should last until you move the marker or reach the marker itself. Other than that I don't have any issues with the game atm.

Overall I'd have to say that I was pretty impressed with how well made this game is and I think that it's worth your time if you're into games like these. Rock and Stone Brodas!

This is a great game that has a lot of replayability.  You'll have some moments of chilled out exploration and mining followed by frantic fights for survival. Its great fun even alone but it really shines with some friends.  There is an unlockable perk system that allows you to realy customize your play style.  If you like co-op shooter, its honestly a must have.
